invariants: A fitting existing owner is reused instead of creating a competing implementation.
A semantic duplicate is removed only after callers move and no independent contract remains.
A dynamic, generated, or external reference is unknown until targeted evidence resolves it; unknown is never silently treated as safe to delete or safe to complete.
Retired symbols and behavior descriptions are removed or updated across code, tests, configuration, telemetry, comments, docs, version text, and metadata.
Formal model-effect collection remains unrun; this change makes no general capability claim.

remove: README.md's implication that examples/effect-experiment-v9/preregistration.json is already a completed artifact

retain.removal_condition: Remove or regenerate only when a new preregistered effect experiment supersedes V9.
retain.observability: V9 manifest and isolation audit hashes

confirmed_current: V9 preregistration is generated only immediately before formal collection
Frozen V9 Skill snapshots remain retained inputs

safeguards.name: owner reuse guard
safeguards.rationale: The checkpoint requires an existing owner search and records reuse_existing_owner before adding a parallel implementation.

safeguards.name: semantic duplicate guard
safeguards.rationale: The checkpoint requires duplicate-code/static-analysis tooling or normalized control-flow, contract, and call-site inspection.

safeguards.name: unknown-reference stop
safeguards.rationale: Dynamic, generated, and external paths require targeted runtime/registry/configuration evidence before completion.

safeguards.name: description-drift guard
safeguards.rationale: Old symbols, behavior phrases, comments, version notes, changelog entries, examples, and metadata are explicitly synchronized.

design_boundary.rationale: SKILL.md owns the normative checkpoint; README, metadata, trap corpus, and contract tests are synchronized consumers.

dependency_audit.rationale: No dependency or import edge was added; existing repository tools remain preferred.

extension_decision.rationale: This is a policy refinement and adds no runtime extension point.

data_ownership.rationale: No mutable business or personal data path changed.

error_model.rationale: Unresolved retirement evidence is an explicit unknown/blocked outcome rather than silent retention or deletion.

contract_evolution.rationale: The Skill contract gains an ordered checkpoint while preserving Level 0, Level 1, and Level 2 semantics and frozen experiment inputs.

operational_budget.rationale: Policy text and deterministic package tests do not change a production resource budget.

threat_boundary.rationale: The guard prevents accidental deletion of dynamically or externally consumed paths and prevents stale metadata from directing unsafe edits.

delivery_lifecycle.rationale: All changes remain one reviewable package scope and are verified before the atomic commit.

release_recovery.rationale: No deployable runtime or rollout configuration changed.

data_migration.rationale: No schema or persistent application data changed.

configuration_secrets.rationale: No runtime secret or environment contract changed.

dependency_supply_chain.rationale: No package or lockfile dependency changed.

operational_knowledge.rationale: README and the Skill checkpoint document cleanup order, evidence, stopping behavior, and V9 artifact lifecycle.

reproducibility.rationale: Focused/full unittest commands, basedpyright, quick_validate, and git diff checks are captured as hash-bound outputs.
